explanation: Combines the lower bound k ≥ 5 (EGMRSS75/Juhász, still true though Tsaturian has since improved it to k ≥ 6) with the upper bound 'some k ≤ 10,000,000'. erdosproblems.com/188 says Erdős and Graham claim k ≤ 10^7 'more or less' but give no proof. Tagging the conjunction `research solved` therefore overstates what is established for the upper-bound half. The lower bound could also be updated to 6.
